item.title: How Long Does Custom Software Take to Build?
item.description: A plain-English look at how long a first release of custom software really takes, what drives the schedule, and where projects quietly lose weeks along the way.

item.title: Do You Need a Web Developer or a Web Designer?

item.title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Minneapolis?

item.title: Case Study: Works of Heart
